name: Eye of the Beholder
storyline: In Eye of the Beholder, you play as a mysterious witch named Delilah. Using the power that an eldritch god has granted you. You are tasked to escape the prison you find yourself in. Around every corner there are monsters that can only be seen using the help of Balor and Morgan, a sentient eye with two personalities. Balor and Morgan may not see things the same way but they both will help you escape with your life and help you achieve your goal.
summary: Eye of the Beholder is a stealth-based horror game. Flee monsters and conquer your memories to gain power. See the unseen, turn your memory to ash, and escape with your sanity intact.
